title: Certifications
summary: Credentials and courses with weight: networking, data, regulation, and research.

items.title: Research Paper Writing for Computer Science
items.blurb: Writing computer science research papers: structure, rigor, and publication practice.
body: FIUSAC workshop/course on writing research papers in computer science: structure, clarity, and academic standards.
Direct bridge toward the portfolio’s research track.

items.title: Regulatory Innovation Mechanisms
items.blurb: Regulatory innovation mechanisms in the digital ecosystem — ITU.
body: International Telecommunication Union training on regulatory innovation mechanisms in digital and technology environments.
Policy and regulation context to complement technical work in security and infrastructure.

items.title: Building AI-Powered Search with MongoDB Vector Search
items.blurb: Semantic search and embeddings with MongoDB Vector Search for AI-powered products.
body: Course on building AI-powered search with MongoDB Vector Search: embeddings, vector indexes, and semantic retrieval.
Useful for RAG, meaning-based search, and products with unstructured data.

items.title: CCNA: Introduction to Networks
items.blurb: Networking intro: OSI/TCP-IP models, addressing, and basic device configuration.
body: First CCNA module: networking principles, protocols, IP addressing, and introductory device configuration.
Formal networking start after IT Essentials.

items.title: IT Essentials: PC Hardware and Software
items.blurb: Foundations of hardware, software, and system support — Cisco Networking Academy.
body: Cisco Networking Academy course on PC assembly, configuration, OS support, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on base for technical support and a path into networking tracks.
